reuse.why: Routes the new option through the existing getCategoryIdsSkippedByMonthWideActions selection helper that every month-wide action already calls.

duplication.why: Removes the three copies of the hidden-filtering SQL so the hidden rule is decided once; only the per-action flag plumbing and the pre-existing category query/income check are repeated.

placement.why: The rule change sits in the shared exclusion helper in budget/actions.ts, where the other month-wide exclusions already live.

scope.why: Touches only the month-wide actions, the helper and focused tests.

maintainability.why: One boolean parameter on the helper with a clear default; the six actions still each repeat the same query/skip loop scaffold, which predates the change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions now take the hidden decision from the shared helper instead of their own SQL.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic is introduced; per-action flag forwarding is plumbing.
